fee_notes: Royalty (called 'Royalty and Service Fee') is 10% of Net Revenues, paid weekly. An additional Out-of-Territory Royalty of 15% of Net Revenues earned outside the Territory is charged on top of the standard 10%. Technology Fee starts at $150/month until cumulative Net Revenues reach $1,000,000, then increases to $250/month; LDI may increase up to $500/month maximum. Local Marketing Fund and Marketing and Promotion Fund each capped at 5% of Net Revenues. Local Advertising requirement is the greater of $30,000 or 10% of Net Revenues per calendar year. Call Center Fee is currently $750/month (included in initial fee during first year of operation; may increase up to $1,000/month). Equipment leases: Turf Tamer Stand-On Applicator $335.40/month (84 months) and Turf Tamer Power Seeder $305.96/month (72 months). Holiday Lighting Heroes advertising: greater of $6,000 or 5% of prior year's HOLIDAY LIGHTING HEROES Net Revenues.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty and Service Fee | 10% of Net Revenues | Payable weekly on the Net Revenues of the preceding week | "Net Revenues" are the actual gross revenues collected from customers, whether for cash or credit, plus all other revenues derived from the Business, excluding taxes collected from customers, and refunds and adjustments.
Technology Fee | Currently starts at $150 with a scheduled increase to $250 (subject to additional potential increases—see "Remarks" column) | Payable monthly | The Technology Fee currently is $150 per month until the cumulative Net Revenues of your Business reach $1,000,000, at which time the Technology Fee is currently scheduled to increase to $250 per month (provided, however, that LDI has the right, in its sole judgment, to increase the monthly Technology Fee from time to time during the Franchise Agreement's term, not to exceed $500 per month).
Out-of-Territory Royalty Fee | 15% of Net Revenues earned outside of Strategic-Partner's Territory | Same as Royalty and Service Fee | The 15% Out-of-Territory Royalty is paid in addition to the 10% of Net Revenues paid for the Royalty and Service Fee.
Local Marketing Fund | Maximum of 5% of Net Revenues | To be determined (See note 1) | LDI may require Strategic-Partners to establish local marketing funds.
Marketing and Promotion Fund | Maximum of 5% of Net Revenues | Payable weekly together with the Royalty and Service Fee | LDI will maintain one or more national and regional marketing funds that it directs.
Local Advertising | Unspent amount of required local advertising activities | Within 60 days after end of calendar year | You must spend each calendar year...the greater of $30,000 or 10% of your Net Revenues to market your Business in your Territory.
Call Center Fees | Currently $750 per month (monthly charge begins after your 1st year of operation). | Monthly | We currently do not expect that Call Center Fees will exceed $1,000 per month.
Turf Tamer Stand-On Applicator Lease | $335.40, plus sales tax | Monthly | Payment is due to LDI over an 84-month period.
Turf Tamer Power Seeder Lease | $305.96, plus sales tax | Monthly | Payment is due to LDI over a 72-month period.
